_about: Inputs to the CPU-side arms-per-pod (K) estimate in manifest_wave2.py. Every number is quoted from its source line; none is a result. K rule (campaigns/2026-09-27-delta-screen/STUDY.md (frozen 24c3c90) launch gate 7 (l. 441-452) and Budget 'Arms per pod' (l. 916-925); [DK11]): K is accepted per architecture class and GPU class only if peak GPU memory stays <= 90 % of the card's memory. Estimate: K = floor(0.90 * card_MiB / per_process_MiB). The production packs read K from k_result.json (the memory canary, canary_k.py) when it covers the (class, GPU product); otherwise the manifest is a PLANNING manifest.

measurements.what: anchor arms A-s1, A-s2, D-s1 (E: d24/h2/L1/FFN32, no PE, batch 2,790, Chang quantizers), nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps, stable across samples, K=6 pilot pod with 5 processes resident
measurements.source: campaigns/2026-09-26-training-batch/RUN.md l. 35-39 (card 23,028 MiB) and l. 215-217 (per process), commit c9c9942

measurements.what: anchor E1-s1 (one head); no Delta cell uses E1

anchor C'-s1 3rd attempt (A07 on the OLD SAT quantizer, pilot-only arm); a proxy, not A07 under the Chang quantizers. A07-350-s1 (A07, Chang quantizers) OOM'd on all 3 attempts at K=6 and has no reading
measurements.status: measured proxy; not used for K, shown beside the planning value

planning_k._about: used only where no measurement or canary covers the (class, GPU class); labelled PLANNING in every pack

A07.source: wave-2 STUDY (frozen 24c3c90) Budget 'Arms per pod' l. 916-920: A07 at K = 3 on 23-24 GB products (A10, 3090), K = 5-6 on >= 45 GB. 24GB changed 3 -> 2 on 2026-09-29 by the orchestrator: the Delta A07 canary (A10, bundle 705a554b) ran out of memory at K=3 (8,446 MiB per process; k_result.json k_accepted 2; campaigns/2026-09-27-delta-screen/RUN.md 2026-09-29 03:22Z and 06:08Z). The rest of this file's uncommitted edits are another session's (2026-09-29 ~03:32Z).

E.source: wave-2 STUDY (frozen 24c3c90) Budget l. 917-919: E at K = 4 on 23-24 GB (floor(0.9 x 23,028 / 4,354)); K = 5 only if the measured peak fits

other.source: no basis: an architecture class other than E or A07 takes the planning K of its base arm's class and is flagged k_class_unmeasured (STUDY launch gate 7 asks for its own canary)

24GB.note: product names verbatim from the anchor pilot-job.json nodeAffinity; K is set by the smallest card of the class (A10, measured); RTX-3090 memory not measured here

45GB+.note: no card memory measured; planning K only until the canary runs on this product

40GB.note: planning K only; a product-specific canary and full pack-size search are required

80GB.note: baseline K=5 is only a starting point; increase K in a product-specific canary and certify throughput/utilization before production

access_policy: A100 is eligible when live quota and node capacity permit, subject to the same product-specific timing, memory, utilization and matching gates as other GPUs (Kai decision 2026-09-28; docs/infrastructure/gpu-selection-policy.md)

host_memory_rule.rule: per pack: BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB = 2,100 + 5 x H MiB; pod memory per arm = max(6, ceil(limit/1,024)) Gi
host_memory_rule.source: wave-2 STUDY (frozen 24c3c90) Budget PACK-MEM l. 920-925 (baseline 2.1 GB + slope x H at the gate-14 limit of 5 MB/epoch; 4.6 / 7.1 / 12.1 GB at H 500 / 1,000 / 2,000) and gate 14 l. 471-476; anchor gate code ablation.rss_gate_from_env (42abed4b)
